name: light-remote
description: Remote files, commands, managed processes, and PTY sessions on user-owned devices through a policy-bounded MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Remote files, commands, processes, and PTY sessions on your own devices.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to user-owned devices through OAuth, explicit device targeting, durable sessions, local policy boundaries, filesystem tools, managed processes, and real PTY/ConPTY terminals.
defaultPrompt: List my available Light Remote devices and their allowed capabilities.
Open a durable session on my selected device and inspect the workspace.
Run the project tests on my selected device and summarize the result.
Open an interactive terminal on my selected device, run pwd, then close the terminal.
